policy: Provisional classification of the resource introduced by each catalogue entry, not of its contained materials. Use interactive resource for online databases, search/browse services, catalogues and general web pages as a local export policy. Apply dataset/software exceptions only where the entry describes a separately distributed resource. Landing pages can describe datasets or software. Offering some downloadable data does not turn a whole service into a dataset. This is not a claim that all web pages meet the COAR definition precisely.
legacy_type_policy: Preserve every original dc:type value as local contentType metadata outside jpcoar:jpcoar, tagged with its source field. Do not let these legacy values determine the new resource type. Include them as labelled explanatory text in the standard-only exchange XML.

review_notes.reason: The entry introduces a corpus-family website with multiple corpora and access methods. Individual downloadable corpora could be described separately.
Geoshape is a repository/service containing several distinct datasets, rather than one identified dataset.
A trained BERT model is a candidate exception, but the intended scope (model weights versus code) and JPCOAR 2.0 mapping need review. Keep the provisional default until resolved.
A repository landing page for a former search system does not alone establish which separately distributed data/software the entry identifies; review required.
JDCat is a discovery catalogue of datasets, not a single dataset.
The audio-corpus list introduces multiple resources, not a specific corpus package.
IDR is a repository/service introducing multiple data resources.
Meiji-Portraits is the website introduced by this entry. Its description also links a separate DOI dataset; the website is not reclassified as that dataset.
The title says dataset in Japanese but database in English and describes browsing; identify a reusable data package before separating it.
A curated list of NLP software/data resources is not itself each listed software package.
The geospatial platform provides access to multiple datasets; it is not a single dataset.
